venue.details: The parking lot is very small. If the parking lot gets filled, there is overflow parking in the field across the street.

information: The registration fee is $15. There is a 60 person competitor limit with no at-the-door registration. To register, please follow all Instructions on the registration payment tab. Inproper completion of these steps may result in a delay of Registration. If you do not see your name on the compeitors tab after 48 hours of registering, please contact me to resolve the issue. The event list consists of: Rubik's Cube, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, BLD, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Clock, Skewb, Sq-1, 4 BLD, 5 BLD, and MBLD.
